meta.name: prisma-mongodb-upgrade
meta.description: Decision and migration guide for Prisma ORM MongoDB projects on v6, which have no upgrade path to v7. Use when a MongoDB project asks about upgrading Prisma, when "upgrade to prisma 7" comes up in a project with provider = "mongodb", or when evaluating a move to Prisma Next. Triggers on "upgrade prisma mongodb", "prisma 7 mongodb", "mongodb prisma migration", "prisma next mongodb".

copy.tagline: 规划 MongoDB 项目在 Prisma 升级受阻时的迁移路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的 MongoDB 项目 Prisma 停在 v6,升级无路。
copy.tagline_en: Chart a migration path for MongoDB projects stuck on Prisma v6
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a MongoDB project on Prisma v6 and need a way to move forward.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 对 MongoDB 项目的 Prisma 版本问题会说明:v6 是 MongoDB 最后一个稳定大版本,v7 没有 MongoDB 连接器;然后按决策表引导用户迁到 Prisma Next 或留在 v6,并给出停留卫生建议。绝不建议升级 Prisma 7,也不会默认改写 SQL 数据库。
howto.when: 当用户表明 MongoDB 项目要升级 Prisma,或谈到“upgrade prisma mongodb”“prisma 7 mongodb”等关键词,或评估迁移 Prisma Next 时触发。

say.note: Claude 会提示先规划原生驱动方案,或暂留 v6。

howto.what_en: Explains v6 is the terminal classic-ORM major for MongoDB and v7 has no MongoDB connector; guides migration to Prisma Next vs. staying on v6, with hygiene steps. Never advises upgrading to Prisma 7 or switching database engines.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a MongoDB project asks about upgrading Prisma, when keywords like "upgrade prisma mongodb" or "prisma 7 mongodb" appear, or when evaluating a move to Prisma Next.

say_en.text: Can my MongoDB project upgrade to Prisma 7?
say_en.note: Claude says no, outlining Prisma Next or staying on v6.
